title: 12 Best Rendang in Padang
description: The best rendang in Padang, Indonesia — where the dish was born. From Restoran Selamat's legendary 100kg-a-day rendang to wood-fired Randang Rajo Rajo. Interactive map included.

places.name: Restoran Selamat

redditQuotes.text: Kalo bagi saya orang asli Kota Padang, kalo the best bagi kami Rendang Restoran Selamat." (As a native Padang local, the best rendang for us is Restoran Selamat.) — TikTok comment from local · 3 Rendang Recommendations in Padang, Feb 2025 "Restoran Selamat has been around since 1953 and processes 80 to 100 kg of rendang daily — which often sells out within hours.

places.verdict: The undisputed rendang king of Padang.

comparison.best for: Rendang Hitam Legend in Pasar Raya, Padang Barat
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 954 Google reviews · Rendang Hitam Legend · Pasar Raya, Padang Barat
comparison.why it made the list: The undisputed rendang king of Padang. 70+ years in business, located right at Pasar Raya (the city's central market), and their dark, slightly wet rendang has a depth of flavor you won't find anywhere else. The fact that locals — not tourists — call this the best says everything. Arrive before noon or risk heartbreak.
comparison.what to order: Restoran Selamat, a legendary rendang hitam spot in Pasar Raya, Padang Barat, offers their signature rendang daging sapi for Rp 25,000–Rp 50,000/person. This signature dish has been served since 1953. It's dark, almost black, with a slightly wet texture that distinguishes it from drier rendang elsewhere. Pair with steamed white rice and their gulai nangka (jackfruit curry). Come early — they sell out 80–100 kg of rendang daily, often by early afternoon.

places.verdict: This is rendang the way your Minang grandmother makes it — cooked for 7 hours over real wood fire.

comparison.why it made the list: This is rendang the way your Minang grandmother makes it — cooked for 7 hours over real wood fire. No shortcuts, no gas stoves.
